biotools.summary: Utilvo is a privacy-preserving client-side biomedical imaging and scientific information processing suite developed by Islam Ayoub (ORCID: 0009-0002-1503-5639). Executed entirely within the browser sandbox using WebAssembly (Wasm), WebGL2, Web Workers, and the Web Cryptography API, Utilvo enables zero-trust local inspection of clinical DICOM (.dcm) radiology studies, 3D NIfTI (.nii / .nii.gz) neuroimaging volumes, 12-lead ECG/EKG waveform recordings, and structured research documents without transmitting raw patient data (PHI) to external servers.

bioschemas.summary: Utilvo is a privacy-preserving client-side information processing framework and browser-based scientific data analysis suite developed by Islam Ayoub (ORCID: 0009-0002-1503-5639). Executed entirely within the browser sandbox using WebAssembly (Wasm), Web Workers, and the Web Cryptography API (AES-GCM-256, SHA-256), Utilvo enables zero-trust local analysis of sensitive biomedical, genomic, clinical, and structured research documents (JSON, CSV, XML, PDF, and scientific imaging) without transmitting raw files to external servers.
